scope: Local disposable PostgreSQL only; no remote database mutations or application runtime changes
query_change: Both projection INSERTs use alias existing and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET data = excluded.data WHERE existing.data IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.data

commands.green: sh deploy/verify-schema.sh > evidence/infrastructure/projection-write-amplification/green.log 2>&1 (fresh bootstrap plus upgrade migration)

checks: Fresh bootstrap and additive upgrade apply successfully
Original read purity, CAS, projection deletion, role grants, RLS and restrictive Storage-policy checks pass
Separate committed transactions prove unchanged entity and audit xmin remain stable
Changed entity and audit JSON update with new xmin
Stale CAS returns committed=false without altering authoritative document or projections
Injected projection CHECK failure after document UPDATE rolls back revision, document/projection JSON, projection cardinality and xmin

limits: No hosted availability or latency improvement measured by this local regression
The authoritative document still updates on every successful CAS; projection scans/conflict checks/delete scans remain
Existing evidence files preserved; remote upgrade/application verification belongs to the coordinating agent

rest_adapter.storage: NOT_RUN: no Supabase Storage service in this disposable database harness
rest_adapter.qualification: Actual local SQL/PostgREST responses; only /rest/v1 prefix forwarding and deterministic initial-read scheduling occur in the harness. No hosted mutation or Storage HTTP verification.
